environment.build: apps/web webpack-cli --mode production with CI_PACKAGE=1 (unminified) and --devtool false, served statically; the 18 changed files on the workbench hash identically to the head (combined sha256 of per-file sha256 values ba3bea059032e93c9ccc8b90a97440f4a6c5803b87027ef8320b9297b5dc3dbe)
environment.config: default_server_config pointing at the local homeserver, disable_guests, and the two Poda modules; every other value from apps/web/src/SdkConfig.ts DEFAULTS
environment.users: @demo:localhost (creator/admin of seeded rooms) and @mira:localhost (power level 0 except in the direct message she created)

rooms.restricted: join_rule restricted, allow rule names a space, created by API
rooms.invite: join_rule invite, two members, created by API
rooms.dm: trusted_private_chat direct message created by Mira
rooms.poda_created: invite-only room created by Demo through the New room dialog

tests.command: pnpm exec vitest run (the eight files named in O-000020 Implementation), from apps/web

legs.P1: As Demo: public and restricted rooms show header buttons Open room settings, Room info, Threads, Room info (no Video call, no Voice call); invite room and DM show Video call and Voice call. As Mira: public room no call buttons; DM and the Poda-created room show both.
legs.P2: As Demo and Mira: public and restricted composers show Emoji, Attachment, More options; invite room, DM and Poda-created room show Emoji, Attachment, Voice Message on the bar, and Voice Message is absent from the overflow menu.
legs.P3: Poda-created room m.room.power_levels events: m.poll.start 100, org.matrix.msc3381.poll.start 100. Mira PUT m.poll.start and org.matrix.msc3381.poll.start: 403 M_FORBIDDEN each; Demo: 200 each; Mira m.room.message: 200. Mira's composer in that room: Emoji, Attachment, Voice Message and no More options (no poll control); Demo's overflow menus offered Poll.
legs.P4: Overflow menus in all five rooms for both users contained only Poll or nothing; no Sticker or Location item.
legs.P5: Developer mode off: message Options menu Forward, Share, Report, Remove. Developer mode on (account level): Forward, Share, Report, View source, Remove. Reset to off afterwards.
legs.P6: Room header offers Threads in every room; room info panel items Invite, People, Pinned messages, Files, Extensions, Copy link, Polls, Export Chat, Settings, Report room, Leave room (no Threads); the space panel has no Threads button.

notes: The API-created public room keeps the homeserver's default poll power level, so Mira's composer still offers Poll there; P-000020 Residual and G-000027 cover rooms not created from Poda.
Messages sent through the API into the encrypted Poda-created room render with an unencrypted-message warning; this is a property of the test sends, not of the observed controls.
